digest.component_or_area: backend-neutrality sweep and Jira adapter architecture (test_backend_neutrality.py, inbound_fields.py)
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain rooted at rebar_reconciler package root to allow both Jira adapters to share it without opening a sibling-adapter edge that J7 forbids

The backend-neutrality sweep exemption is a deliberate architectural cost, not temporary relocation debt, and must document why the module cannot be moved to adapters/jira/ (breaks DC seal) or adapters/jira_family/ (violates mirror rule for root-core importers)

The sweep exemption explanation must state that moving to jira_family/ would break the rule that core importers (inbound_differ.py, peer_state.py) cannot consume that layer, and that routing around it via path-string loads would launder rather than satisfy the AST gate
The test diagnostic and docstrings in test_backend_neutrality.py must remove the obsolete claim that the module will be relocated in ticket 556a and instead explain the durable J7 constraint
